description: A Python script for load testing AgentField's execution flows by exercising /execute and /execute/async endpoints with configurable parameters, collecting latency and status metrics, and supporting nested payload templates.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: Class for collecting and summarizing load test metrics such as latencies, status counts, and HTTP codes.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses a header string into key and value, supporting ':' and '=' delimiters.

methods.name: load_template
methods.description: Loads and validates a JSON template file, ensuring it is valid after formatting with placeholders.

methods.name: build_parser
methods.description: Constructs an argument parser with options for load testing parameters.

methods.name: Metrics.record
methods.description: Records a single request's latency, status, HTTP code, and exceptions.

methods.name: Metrics.summary
methods.description: Generates a summary dictionary with latency percentiles, counts, and throughput.

methods.name: build_payload_factory
methods.description: Creates a function to generate request payloads based on a template or defaults.

methods.name: load_scenarios
methods.description: Loads load scenarios from a JSON scenario file, supporting overrides and default scenario.

methods.name: scrape_metrics
methods.description: Fetches metrics from a Prometheus endpoint, extracting specified metric values.

methods.name: wait_for_async_completion
methods.description: Polls the async execution status endpoint until completion or timeout.

methods.name: invoke_request
methods.description: Performs an individual load test request, handling sync/async modes and recording metrics.

methods.name: safe_json
methods.description: Safely parses JSON from an HTTP response, returning raw text on failure.

methods.name: run_load
methods.description: Runs the load test with specified arguments, collecting metrics and handling failures.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments, executes load scenarios, and outputs results.
